basic_info.description: Rarely available, vacant two-unit building on a sunny, flat Noe Valley block. This property has been in the family for more than 50 years and has great bones, offering an excellent opportunity to customize and update with your personal touches. 135 Duncan: Spacious lower unit with generous foyer and stained glass window, three bedrooms, two full baths, eat-in kitchen and adjacent living/dining space overlooking the garden. 137 Duncan: Upper unit with abundant natural light, two bedrooms and one bath. The double parlor is perfect for office or den and adjoins one of the two large bedrooms. Rear living/dining area has treetop and garden views and is adjacent to the eat-in kitchen with stainless-steel appliances and walk-in pantry. Both units have flexible floor plans and feature lovely period details that include built-in buffets, coved and box beam ceilings. Each flat has newly refinished wood floors and laundry porches with side-by-side washer/dryers. Direct access from both levels to the tranquil, south-facing garden with patio, fig and lemon trees. Large garage for multiple cars and storage. Desirable neighborhood location near Church St retail/transit corridor, Sanchez Slow Street, Noe and Mission restaurants. Easy access to tech shuttles, BART, freeways.
